Netanagri Full Episode:
Sonia Gandhi’s autobiography was initially set to be published by Penguin Random House India, but what exactly happened that led to Penguin not publishing the book? Rajdeep Sardesai mentioned that Sonia was unwilling to change even a single word, and there was also a request to remove a paragraph concerning China; perhaps this is why an agreement could not be reached, and subsequently, HarperCollins India published the book in India.
